name: recreio-arcade-g1-g2
description: Monorepo do Recreio Arcade: API oficial (G1, real) + Portal Web (G2).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run build
